message.content:
## Recent developments
- **Nvidia Acquisition Inquiry:** The U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) launched an inquiry into Nvidia’s proposed $12.93 billion acquisition of Hugging Face, focusing on potential impacts on AI market competition and control over central AI model distribution channels.
- **Leadership & Open-Source Commitment:** Following shifts including Jensen Huang's exit considerations/changes regarding the integration, Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue publicly reaffirmed the company's commitment to fighting for open-source and open-weight AI.
- **ProtoStar Initiative Launch:** Hugging Face partnered with universities (via the Open Forum for AI) to launch **ProtoStar**, an open science initiative designed to leverage public research and datasets. Carnegie Mellon University hosted the inaugural ProtoStar Climate Risk Intelligence challenge in early November 2026.

## Talking points
- **Regulatory Scrutiny:** How is the DOJ inquiry into Nvidia's acquisition affecting internal roadmap planning, developer relations, and enterprise trust on the platform?
- **Platform Independence:** What safeguards are being put in place to ensure Hugging Face remains an open, neutral ecosystem for multi-vendor model distribution despite impending corporate consolidation?
- **Ecosystem Growth:** With science dataset sharing tripling year-over-year and the rollout of initiatives like ProtoStar, how can the company further monetize or support academic-corporate collaboration?

## Open questions
- What is the current timeline for the DOJ's antitrust review of the Nvidia-Hugging Face acquisition?
- How do enterprise clients view the potential integration with Nvidia, and are there any signs of churn toward alternative model hubs?
- What are the primary objectives for expanding the ProtoStar open science initiative following the CMU pilot challenge?

## Sources
- [Shattered.io - Nvidia + Hugging Face: 5 DOJ Probe Risks [2026]](https://shattered.io/nvidia-hugging-face-doj-inquiry-12-93b-meta-becerra-pac-2026)
- [Yahoo Finance - Hugging Face cofounder: Open-weight AI models were 'our savior'](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/hugging-face-cofounder-open-weight-ai-models-were-our-savior-220000916.html)
- [TechCrunch - Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open-source AI after Jensen Huang’s exit](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/hugging-face-ceo-vows-to-keep-fighting-for-open-source-ai-after-jensen-huangs-exit)
- [EdTech Innovation Hub - Hugging Face launches ProtoStar open science and AI initiative](https://www.edtechinnovationhub.com/news/hugging-face-and-universities-launch-protostar-to-put-public-research-to-work-with-ai)
- [Carnegie Mellon University - CMU to Host Challenge to Put Scientific Data to Work With AI](https://www.cmu.edu/news/stories/archives/2026/october/cmu-to-host-challenge-to-put-scientific-data-to-work-with-ai)
